# Skin XML Inventory

Element and attribute inventory of every offline XML corpus in this repo, cross-checked against the reference docs. Built-in skin XML is not strict XML (raw `&`, `&&`, and `>` inside quoted attribute values), so this report is produced by a tolerant quote-aware tokenizer, not an XML parser.

141 distinct elements observed across all families; 33 undocumented.
